description: Water Resources Agency open data platform (水利署水利資料開放平台) is a data portal run by Water Resources Agency, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan. The platform offers real-time and historical reservoir, river level, rainfall, groundwater and flood-potential data and management-area layers of the agency as files and APIs. Coverage: Taiwan. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as json, csv, shp; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("首頁 - 經濟部水利署水利資料開放平台") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support reservoir and flood studies in Taiwan. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
